definitions.match_rate: (primary + Fallback + similarity matches) / alignment positions, including gaps
definitions.mismatch_rate: Unresolved mismatches and gaps / alignment positions; 0 when no positions are processed

definitions.fallback_error_count: Mismatches and gaps in separate Fallback alignment with similarity enabled
